info.title: CF Meet public API — meetings
info.description: CF Meet Meeting Service. `/api/v1`: legacy meeting API (retained for compatibility). `/api/v2`: Phase 2 meeting domain (MeetingSpace → ConferenceSession → ConferenceParticipant → ParticipantSession). v2 errors use `{ success:false, error:{ code, message, requestId } }` with stable semantic codes.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Space UUID, meeting code, legacy meeting UUID or legacy code

allowedDomains.description: DOMAIN_RESTRICTED / EXTERNAL_ONLY: verified email domains treated as internal.

appointmentRef.description:
HEALTHCARE_APPOINTMENT: optional appointment reference forwarded to the
appointment authority (which alone decides).

requireVerifiedRevocation.description:
Fail closed when an authenticated session's revocation cannot be verified
(always on for HEALTHCARE and HIGH_SECURITY security profiles).

guestSessionTtlSecs.description: Lifetime of guest / external participant sessions.

requireExternalContext.description: External participants must present an external authorization context.

waitingRoomForced.description: Waiting room applies even when the space says OFF (hosts stay exempt).

email.description: Matched only against verified account emails.

userId.description: Registered CF Meet user. Exactly one of `userId` / `email`.

answer.description: Optional written answer (omit when answered live).

ArtifactView.description:
Public artefact projection: never exposes storage keys, provider references,
internal diagnostics or signed URLs.

deletionPending.description: Deletion requested; no new access is issued.

failureCode.description: Public-safe failure category (internal diagnostics are never returned).

breakoutIds.description: RANDOM / BALANCED: target rooms (default: every CREATED/OPEN room).

onlyUnassigned.description: Only distribute participants without an assignment (default true).

unassigned.description: Eligible participants left unassigned (all rooms at capacity).

AttendanceReport.description:
Signed, short-lived, single-object read access (never persisted).
Conference attendance (Part J attendance contract). Attendance time is merged from
participant-session intervals, so multi-device presence is never double counted.

enhanced.description: Enhanced semantic audit (join, artefact access, consent, admin access).

credentialRefreshRequired.description:
Request a fresh credential for the new context
(`POST /api/v2/conferences/{id}/media-credential`).

BreakoutRecordingPolicy.description: Breakout recording metadata only — recording itself is Part G.

participantIds.description: Assigned participant ids — only for roles that manage breakouts.

skipped.description: In a state that does not allow this transition.

unchanged.description: Already in the requested state (idempotent retry).

ChatPolicyUpdateRequest.description: Chat-only subset of the collaboration policy.

countdownSeconds.description: Grace period before participants return (0 = immediate, max 600).

CollaborationPolicy.description: Complete effective collaboration policy of a conference.

aiNotice.description: Show an AI-processing notice before join (no AI runs in Part F).

audioLocked.description: Conference-wide microphone lock for every role without `participant.mute`.

mainChatVisibleInBreakouts.description: Whether participants inside a breakout still see (read-only) main chat.

requiredConsents.description: Consents an attendee must grant before admission (pre-join contract).

videoLocked.description: Conference-wide camera lock for every role without `participant.mute`.

CollaborationPolicyPatch.description: Sparse override. Unknown fields are rejected.

collaborationVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency: the `collaborationVersion` the client last read.

CollaborationStateResponse.description: Canonical collaboration snapshot (REST recovery after realtime gaps).

eventSequence.description: Realtime cursor this snapshot is at least as new as.

changed.description: False when the request was an idempotent no-op (e.g. already LIVE).

recordingState.description:
Part G: recording indicator (`OFF` / `REQUESTED` / `RECORDING` / `STOPPING`) —
the authoritative recovery source after a reconnect.

ConferenceSummary.description: Minimal conference info included in space responses.

active.description: The processing is currently active in this conference.

required.description: Affirmative consent is required before this processing runs.

recordingNotice.description: Recording notice is always shown while capture is active.

count.description: Number of automatically numbered rooms ("Room N").

conferenceId.description: Restrict the invitation to one occurrence.

expiresInHours.description: Default 168 (7 days); capped by server policy.

token.description: Raw bearer token. Returned exactly once; only its hash is stored.

organizationId.description: Must be an organization the caller verifiably belongs to.

passcode.description: Plaintext passcode; only a bcrypt hash is stored and it is never returned.

internalNote.description: Administrative note — stored, never shown to the participant.

message.description: Safe, human-readable message (never SQL, provider bodies, secrets or paths).

requestId.description: Server-generated correlation ID (also in the `x-request-id` response header).

ErrorCode.description: Stable, semantic public error codes for the Phase 2 meeting domain (spec v1.1 §5).

ErrorEnvelope.description: OpenAPI description of the public error envelope.

resyncRequired.description: True when the cursor cannot be served: refetch `canonical` and resume from `cursor`.

sourceArtifactId.description: READY transcript artefact of this conference.

consents.description: Part F: explicit consents granted before admission (see the pre-join contract).

displayName.description: Presentation name only — never identity. Required for guests.

externalContext.description:
Opaque context forwarded to a server-side access authority (e.g. a HealthNet
appointment token). Never treated as proof by the meeting service itself.

previousSessionId.description: Reconnect: supersede this earlier session of the same participant.

participantToken.description:
Server-issued participant credential for non-registered actors (send as
`X-Participant-Token`). Returned only when newly issued.

JoinRealtimeInfo.description:
Realtime subscription and recovery resources for a joined (or waiting) participant.
Paths are relative to the API origin; authorization is re-evaluated on every call.

conferencePath.description: Canonical conference state — the primary recovery resource.

enabled.description: Whether the conference WebSocket stream is available (`FEATURE_CONFERENCE_REALTIME_ENABLED`).

eventsPath.description: REST replay of missed events (`?after=<sequence>`; present when `enabled`).

participantPath.description: The caller's own participant state (admission decision fallback when polling).

participantSessionId.description: Close one session; omitted = close all of the caller's sessions.

MeetingProfile.description: The specialized mode a space resolves to.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `before` to fetch older messages; absent at the end.

toBreakoutId.description: Target breakout; null = back to the main conference.

retainPreviousOwner.description: Keep the previous owner as a HOST member (default true).

denialMessage.description: User-visible denial message (internal notes are never exposed).

correct.description: Option ids (choice/ranking) or rating value as string. Stripped from public views.

Quiz: correct option indexes (choice), the exact order (ranking) or `[value]`
(rating). Never returned before the results state allows it.

options.description: Option labels (choice / ranking). Ids `o1…oN` are assigned by the server.

idempotentReplay.description: true when this request was a retry of an already-recorded ballot.

score.description:
Quiz score, only where the results state already allows it (AFTER_VOTE,
non-anonymous).

averageScore.description: Quiz: average score and maximum (aggregate only).

myScore.description: The caller's own score (non-anonymous quiz, results visible).

externalAuthorization.description: Decided by an external authority (e.g. a healthcare appointment).

granted.description: Already granted by the caller's participant (rejoin).

required.description: Must be granted (join request `consents`) before admission.

PreJoinDevices.description: Client-side device contract. The backend never needs device ids for authorization.

backgroundEffects.description: Background blur / replacement run client-side only.

deviceIdentifiersCollected.description: Device ids, labels and fingerprints are never sent or stored.

speakerSelection.description: Speaker selection depends on the platform (setSinkId support).

identityBearing.description: Always false: a display name never selects identity, role or participant.

suggested.description: Suggested name (profile name for registered users).

joinable.description: Media join is possible right now (LIVE).

title.description: Hidden for sensitive (healthcare / high-security) meetings until authorized.

ProcessingLocation.description: Where processing may run. Ordered from most to least restrictive.

ProfilePolicy.description: The complete effective profile policy of a space / conference.

changes.description: Sparse override (validated against the profile schema; unknown keys rejected).

profilePolicyVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency (`profilePolicyVersion` from the last read).

ProviderEnforcement.description: Provider enforcement state for operations whose media effect is Part E.

sinkDropped.description: Samples the telemetry sink could not take (meeting unaffected).

batchId.description: Client batch id (idempotency for retries; 1–64 chars).

participantSessionId.description:
Optional: one of the caller's own active sessions (resolved server-side
otherwise). Another participant's session is rejected.

providerRegion.description: Provider edge the client connected to (sanitized; operations-only).

averagePositions.description: Ranking: option id → average position (1 = first).

correct.description: Quiz: correct answer, once the results state allows it.

ratingDistribution.description: Rating: value → count, and the average.

texts.description: Text answers (managers only; never attributed for anonymous polls).

delivered.description: Transient: false when the realtime fanout was unavailable (nothing is stored).

sequence.description: Gap-free per-conference sequence (commit order) — the replay cursor.

cursor.description: Current conference event sequence (start cursor for a fresh subscriber).

websocketPath.description: WebSocket path relative to the API origin.

retentionDays.description: Days a READY recording is kept before the retention worker deletes it.

originalStartAt.description: The occurrence's original start (as generated by the series), any distance ahead.

scheduledEndAt.description: RESCHEDULE only; defaults to the series duration.

appliedToConferenceId.description: Set when the occurrence was already materialized and has been updated.

originalStartLocal.description: Original wall-clock start in the series timezone (exception key).

admissionToken.description:
Opaque admission token (shown once; only its hash is stored). Absent for an
idempotent repeat.

conferenceId.description: Register for one occurrence (optional; otherwise the whole meeting series).

customFields.description: Only keys approved by the profile policy are accepted (string values).

matchedBy.description: How the identifier matched: V2_ID, V2_CODE, LEGACY_ID or LEGACY_CODE.

clampedFields.description: Override fields that a ceiling clamped back (visible to administrators).

misconfigured.description: A stored layer failed validation → restrictive fallback is in force.

version.description: Optional optimistic version of the participant.

externalRoleMapping.description: External role token (e.g. `DOCTOR`) → generic meeting role. Never OWNER.

RolePolicy.description: Controlled per-space / organization overrides of POLICY cells only.

overrides.description: role → permission key → allowed. Only POLICY cells may be overridden.

ScreenSharePolicy.description: Who may publish a screen share (on top of the `screenshare.publish` role grant).

announcement.description: Host-only announcement to the main room (`chat.moderate`).

breakoutId.description: Breakout chat of this room (must be the sender's current breakout).

startLocal.description: First occurrence, wall-clock time in the meeting space timezone.

StageProfile.description: Large-audience architecture: a small interactive stage, a subscribe-only audience.

maxStageParticipants.description: Participants that may publish (every role above VIEWER). 0 = not limited.

viewerCapacity.description: Operational viewer capacity (informational; enforced by space capacity).

StartRecordingRequest.description:
`POST /recordings` body. The client never selects provider ids, storage buckets
or keys.

idempotencyKey.description: Client idempotency key (repeats return the same recording).

sourceRecordingId.description: POST_MEETING: the READY recording to transcribe.

idempotencyKey.description:
Client-chosen retry key: a retry with the same key is acknowledged
idempotently instead of failing as a duplicate ballot.

TrackKind.description: Media track kinds the business layer reasons about.

nextAfter.description: Cursor for the next page (`after` = last sequence).

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version the client last read.

WithdrawalMode.description: What a consent withdrawal does (policy-driven, never one universal rule).

retroactiveDeletion.description: Previously retained artefacts are not deleted by a withdrawal.
